items.title: Tubular Motor Validation
description: Led validation activities for tubular motor solutions, combining manual verification and automated testing approaches.
Contributed to product quality assurance by identifying defects, validating requirements, and supporting release readiness assessments before market deployment.

items.title: EVB NP Validation Automation Framework
description: Contributed to a Python-based BDD automation framework using Behave.
Developed new test steps, extended existing automation scenarios, and contributed bug fixes through pull requests.

items.title: Hardware Sensitivity Test Automation
description: Developed and maintained automated validation solutions for hardware testing using Python and Pytest.

items.title: io-homecontrol Validation Framework

The solution enabled device simulation, protocol communication emulation, and execution of automated validation scenarios.

items.title: Functional Validation Automation Management
